vehicle: NPS AUV II, MSS npsauv.m (Healey and Lienard 1993)

needs_access.citation: A. J. Healey and D. Lienard (1993). Multivariable Sliding Mode Control for Autonomous Diving and Steering of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles, IEEE Journal of Ocean Engineering 18(3):327-339.
needs_access.status: read, pp. 327-339. Sec. III (p. 328): the control input vector holds the four control-surface deflections and the propeller rotational rate, so the propeller rate is an input and the paper has no shaft-speed lag. Appendix and Table of Parameters (pp. 337-338): the force polynomials, and rho = 1000 kg/m^3 and m = 5454.54 kg, where npsauv.m uses 1025 kg/m^3 and W/g = 5443 kg. Every value here is read from MSS npsauv.m; the 93 derivatives and the other values are not compared with the paper's table

derivative_scaling.published_form: nondimensional, scaled by r2=0.5*rho*L^2, r3=0.5*rho*L^3, r4=0.5*rho*L^4, r5=0.5*rho*L^5 (npsauv.m 119-122, Fossen Appendix D.2 prime-scaling); dimensional form is an option beside it, not built here (U6e)

state_vector: x = [u v w p q r xpos ypos zpos phi theta psi delta_r delta_s delta_bp delta_bs n_p] (17), npsauv.m 73-77; hull-only split (npsauv_hull.m) drops the last 5 (12)
input_vector: ui = [delta_r_com delta_s_com delta_bp_com delta_bs_com n_com] (5), npsauv.m 28-35; one first-order actuator lag T_actuator for all five channels (npsauv.m 95), saturated at max_u (npsauv.m 93) before the lag
